Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) found between untreated and proglumide-treated human pancreatic stellate cells

Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) found between untreated and proglumide-treated human pancreatic stellate cells. (A) Volcano plot showing 926 downregulated genes (green) and 2095 upregulated genes (orange) comparing untreated human PSCs to proglumide-treated PSCs. (B) Pancreatic cancer pathway analysis networks show that genes involved in proliferative and metastatic pathways in pancreatic cancer are downregulated by proglumide (shown in blue), and tumor suppressor genes and genes that are involved with apoptosis are upregulated with proglumide treatment of hPSC (shown in orange). Solid lines imply a direct interaction and dashed lines imply an indirect interaction
